summary: Students at an Illinois high school reportedly used AI to generate sexually explicit images of female classmates. The district notified families and police, who opened an investigation involving minors.
technical_summary: Generative image tools were reportedly used by students to create pornographic images using classmates' likenesses, which were then possibly shared between students. The harm stems from deliberate misuse of accessible generation tools; no platform safeguards are described.

sector.quote: students at Lake Zurich High School were reported to have used AI to generate sexually explicit images of female classmates

technology.quote: students at Lake Zurich High School were reported to have used AI to generate sexually explicit images of female classmates

failure_mode.quote: students at Lake Zurich High School were reported to have used AI to generate sexually explicit images of female classmates

affected_population.quote: students at Lake Zurich High School were reported to have used AI to generate sexually explicit images of female classmates

notes: Investigation ongoing; details limited because minors are involved.

summary: Some peer reviewers of Australian Research Council grant applications reportedly used ChatGPT to write assessment reports, prompting warnings about breaching applicants' confidentiality.
technical_summary: Reviewers allegedly pasted confidential grant proposals into a public generative AI chatbot to produce assessor reports. Telltale text such as a regenerate-response label and generic summaries suggested this. The practice exposed confidential material and degraded review quality.
deployers: Peer reviewers for the Australian Research Council

technology.quote: some ARC discovery projects assessor reports have been produced with ChatGPT

failure_mode.quote: may constitute a breach of confidentiality

notes: Allegations based on reports from applicants; not independently confirmed.

summary: A student monitoring system flagged a 15-year-old's written threat on a school laptop, leading to a felony arrest. The student said he did not mean it.
technical_summary: Gaggle scans student activity on school devices and alerts school staff and law enforcement on flagged content. A written threat triggered an alert and an immediate arrest. The system worked as designed, but lacked intent context and routed a minor into criminal enforcement.

sector.quote: a 15-year-old wrote a threat on his school laptop to bring a gun

technology.quote: The threat triggered a Gaggle alert, which notified the school resource deputy, who responded and detained the teen

affected_population.quote: a 15-year-old wrote a threat on his school laptop to bring a gun

notes: System reportedly worked as designed; the student admitted typing the threat but said he did not mean it.

summary: A man in Delhi was arrested for allegedly using AI tools to create explicit images of his ex-girlfriend and spreading them through fake Instagram accounts to harass and defame her.
technical_summary: AI image-morphing tools were reportedly used to generate explicit images from real photos, distributed via many fake Instagram profiles created without verifiable contact details. Police traced the activity using IP logs obtained from Instagram.

sector.quote: The accused allegedly disseminated the AI-generated photos of the woman, his former schoolmate, through fake Instagram profiles

technology.quote: stalking, defaming, and sexually harassing his ex-girlfriend by creating explicit images of her using AI tools

failure_mode.quote: stalking, defaming, and sexually harassing his ex-girlfriend by creating explicit images of her using AI tools

harm_type.quote: launching a calculated and sustained effort to damage her dignity and reputation

affected_population.quote: stalking, defaming, and sexually harassing his ex-girlfriend by creating explicit images of her using AI tools

notes: Police distinguish AI morphing from deepfakes.

summary: A former US law enforcement officer living in Russia reportedly used commercial AI tools to run a network of more than 160 fake news sites spreading Russian-aligned false stories to Western audiences.
technical_summary: Generative tools including ChatGPT and DALL-E 3 were used to mass-produce articles and images for sites imitating local news outlets, mixing rewritten real news with fabrications. Influencers amplified the stories, and researchers warned of a shift toward the US election.
deployers: Operator of a pro-Russia fake news network

sector.quote: built an ever-growing network of more than 160 fake websites that mimic news outlets in the United States, Britain and France

technology.quote: A network of Russia-based websites masquerading as local American newspapers is pumping out fake stories as part of an AI-powered operation

failure_mode.quote: A network of Russia-based websites masquerading as local American newspapers is pumping out fake stories as part of an AI-powered operation

harm_type.quote: There is no question we are beginning to see a shift in focus toward the U.S. election

notes: Subject has denied involvement in some reports.

summary: An empty Waymo robotaxi drove over a small firework in San Francisco on July 4 and caught fire. No one was injured.
technical_summary: An autonomous vehicle drove over an active firework in the road, and the vehicle caught fire. The perception and driving system did not avoid or respond to the roadway hazard. Other Waymo vehicles were also stranded in holiday congestion.

technology.quote: An unoccupied Waymo vehicle caught fire in San Francisco after driving over a firework Saturday night

harm_type.quote: An unoccupied Waymo vehicle caught fire in San Francisco after driving over a firework Saturday night

notes: A separate incident involved a Waymo with passengers driving into a lit firework.

summary: Scammers in Singapore used manipulated video calls to pose as company executives and officials, tricking employees into transferring corporate funds and sharing personal data.
technical_summary: Attackers invited employees by WhatsApp to Zoom calls where digital manipulation altered their appearance to impersonate senior executives or regulators. Victims were instructed to move funds to designated accounts and give identity details.

technology.quote: It is believed that digital manipulation had been used to alter the appearances of the scammers to impersonate these high-ranking executives

failure_mode.quote: It is believed that digital manipulation had been used to alter the appearances of the scammers to impersonate these high-ranking executives

harm_type.quote: victims would be instructed to transfer substantial amounts of funds from their company
Some victims were also asked to disclose personal information such as NRIC and passport details

affected_population.quote: Businesses are being advised to establish protocols for employees to verify the authenticity of any video calls

notes: Authorities believe digital manipulation was used; amounts lost not stated.

summary: Facebook's automated moderation flagged the word hoe in a gardening group as harassment, putting the group at risk of removal.
technical_summary: Automated language moderation misread a gardening tool name as an abusive term, lacking the context a human reviewer would have. Repeated violations can lead to group shutdown, and the moderator found appeal routes unhelpful.

technology.quote: Facebook uses both human moderators and artificial intelligence to root out material that goes against its rules

failure_mode.quote: AI is not always good at context and the nuances of language

summary: Auto insurers reportedly obtain driving-behavior data from automakers and phone apps, often through unclear consent, and use it to score drivers in ways that can affect their rates.
technical_summary: Telematics data from vehicles and apps such as Life360 and MyRadar flows to analytics firms like Arity, which compute driving scores sold to insurers. Opt-in screens obscure what is shared and with whom, and drivers cannot easily see or contest their scores.

technology.quote: The score reflects the safety of your driving habits

failure_mode.quote: the murky consent process means people may not realize what they are opting into
While you can see your credit score, you will have a harder time finding out what your driving score is

harm_type.quote: Experts say most people have no idea the insurance industry can track them this way

notes: Rate impacts are described as possible rather than documented.

summary: An AI agent asked to tidy a desktop reportedly deleted a folder holding about 15 years of family photos. The user recovered the files through an iCloud feature.
technical_summary: Claude Cowork, an agentic file-handling assistant, was granted access to a desktop and asked to remove temporary files. It instead attempted renaming and deleted a photo folder through terminal commands that bypassed Trash, so standard recovery failed initially.

technology.quote: Claude Cowork is an agent-based AI workspace by Anthropic

failure_mode.quote: Instead of cleaning up temporary files, the AI mistakenly targeted and deleted a folder containing over 15,000 irreplaceable photos

notes: Based on the user's own account; files were later recovered.

summary: Two students at a Pennsylvania school allegedly used AI tools to create hundreds of sexualized deepfake images of girls, with about 60 victims identified. Families later sued the school and AI companies.
technical_summary: Generative image tools were used to create and exchange sexualized synthetic images of female classmates over about six months. The school allegedly failed to report or act despite warnings, and legal gaps hampered prosecution under existing child pornography statutes.

technology.quote: hundreds of AI deepfake nude images of girls were created by two former male students

failure_mode.quote: hundreds of AI deepfake nude images of girls were created by two former male students
the school knew about the images and did nothing to protect the victims

harm_type.quote: inflicted emotional harm they will carry with them for the rest of their lives

affected_population.quote: hundreds of AI deepfake nude images of girls were created by two former male students

notes: School and AI company allegations come from a lawsuit and are unproven.

summary: A man in the UK was repeatedly targeted for months by scammers using deepfake videos and images of celebrities to run a romance and prize scam, and he lost about 200 pounds in gift cards.
technical_summary: Scammers rotated AI-generated celebrity personas, fake certificates and doctored IDs to build trust and push prize and romance schemes toward a single vulnerable target, extracting payment through non-refundable gift cards.

technology.quote: after being bombarded with messages from deepfake celebrity accounts on social media

failure_mode.quote: Once a conversation has been started, the scammers often convince victims to buy non-refundable gift cards and send the codes.

notes: Victim is described as having depression; account is self-reported.
